snippet.title: Game Gear Longplay [022] Halley Wars
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by MadMatty

Interesting shooter for the Game Gear.  Alot of spam to dodge in some areas, which doesnt sound like much of an issue as thats a good part of any shootemup, but here you can just dodge everything and forget the enemy.  You gotta back sure they dont get passed you as if that damage meter hits 100%, its game over.  (You can continue but score is reset to 0)

Im not sure if the flickery Hud is a game issue or an emu issue. I hope it doesn't distract too much. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
